name: infinite-audience
description: Explore audience intelligence through the Infinite Audience hosted MCP service.

interface.longDescription:
Infinite Audience provides frictionless access to high-fidelity precision audiences. We enrich your existing data and discover net-new targets, pushing both directly to your activation channels.

Infinite Audience brings identity resolution, consumer data enrichment, and audience discovery into your AI agent. The Infinite Audience Graph connects fragmented first-party records, such as names, addresses, emails, and phone numbers, to persistent, deduplicated consumer identities. Enrich matched records with demographic, household, behavioral, and other attributes to better understand your customers and discover new audiences.

Through the Infinite Audience MCP app, ask your assistant to explore graph data, match and enrich records, build and compare audience segments, and prepare audiences for delivery to marketing channels. Turn scattered customer data into actionable audiences through a conversational workflow.
defaultPrompt: Show me fields I can use to filter an audience.
How many people aged 30 through 50 are in ZIP code 10001?
List my saved audiences and explain how one is composed.

positive.description: Discover supported audience-filter fields with discovery access and no prior platform knowledge. No saved object is required.
positive.prompt: Show me five fields I can use to filter an audience, including what they mean and which comparisons are allowed.
positive.expected_behavior: Up to five audience-filterable fields with names, descriptions, data types, and supported operators. Explain allowed values where provided and indicate whether more fields are available. Do not invent values or require pricing access.

positive.description: Size an unsaved population using geography and age with discovery access. No saved segment or audience is required.
positive.prompt: How many people aged 30 through 50 are in ZIP code 10001? Just give me the count; do not create or export anything.
positive.expected_behavior: A nonnegative count for ZIP code 10001 and inclusive ages 30 through 50. Do not create a saved audience, segment, or export. The exact count may change as the underlying data updates.

positive.description: Discover and inspect a saved segment with discovery access. Assumes at least one accessible segment exists; no specific name or ID is required.
positive.prompt: List up to five saved segments and show the details of one of them, including its type, status and record count.
positive.expected_behavior: List up to five accessible segments, select a segment ID from those results, and report its details, including subtype, status, and record count. Describe an unavailable count as unknown rather than zero. Do not invent an ID or expose another organization’s data.

positive.description: Discover an audience and explain its composition with discovery access. Assumes at least one accessible audience exists; no specific name or ID is required.
positive.prompt: List up to five saved audiences. Pick one and explain which segments it includes or excludes, how they are combined, its record count, and whether it belongs to a campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Select an audience ID from the returned list and explain its included and excluded segments, combination logic, available record count, and campaign association. Clearly identify absent or unavailable information without inventing it. Return only organization-scoped information.

positive.description: Discover active campaigns and inspect audience linkage with discovery access. No specific campaign name or ID is required; an empty campaign list is a valid outcome.
positive.prompt: List up to five active campaigns. If any exist, show the details and linked audiences for one of them; otherwise tell me there are no active campaigns.
positive.expected_behavior: List up to five active campaigns and, if any are returned, inspect one using its returned ID. Report its details and linked audiences, or explicitly state that none are linked. If the list is empty, say there are no active campaigns and do not call get_campaign or invent an ID.

negative.description: Sending messages through a marketing platform is outside this MCP catalog. Listing or delivering an audience is not a send-campaign action.
negative.prompt: Email every person in my audience about our sale.

negative.description: API-key creation is not exposed by this public MCP catalog.
negative.prompt: Create an API key for this organization.

negative.description: This catalog cannot administer an external advertising account.
negative.prompt: Change the bidding strategy in my Google Ads account.

review.commerce_description: Organizations use the plugin through their existing Infinite Audience subscription. Identity matching and audience delivery consume available organization subscription capacity. Capacity estimates and consumption amounts retain their monetary denominations.

publication.release_notes: Align tool and reviewer language with subscription capacity. The data-release tool reads a platform-maintained snapshot without persisting changes.
